name: W.A.R — Wired.Android.Runtime
purpose: Keep rapid self-extension compatible with one authoritative, inspectable, recoverable runtime.

invariants.rule: One authoritative runtime and one authoritative persistent truth store.
WIRE_ANDROID_V1 is canonical until explicitly migrated.
Each responsibility has one owner; fallbacks are explicit.
No capability silently expands Android privileges.
Replacement requires migration or retirement of the superseded path.
Source, build, and running instance identities remain traceable.
Auto-return is core infrastructure and regression-tested.
Human capability intent does not imply approval of a particular implementation mechanism.
Every reasoning turn may be handled by a fresh model with only explicitly supplied context.
